name: The Soggy Boot Tavern
description: A low-ceilinged tavern smelling of peat smoke and ale. The Dark keeps a crossbow under the bar.
pointsOfInterest: Wanted poster on the wall — Commander Voss, 50gp reward
Back room rumored to be used for smuggling

name: Swamp Road
description: A crumbling road cutting south through the marsh. Dangerous after dark.
pointsOfInterest: Abandoned toll booth at the crossroads
